CustomField.formula:
CASE(ETC_customer_relationship__c , "Excellent / Strong Intimacy / Active", 0.25, "Previous Customer / Minor to Medium Intimacy", 0.15, "New Customer / No Intimacy", 0.05, 3) +
CASE( ETC_position__c , "Sole Source / Incumbent", 0.25, "Well within our market / Go-To for this capability", 0.15, "ETC actively trying to enter this market / capability", 0.05, 3) +
CASE( ETC_technical_solution__c , "Technology Leader", 0.2, "Shaped Requirements", 0.15, "Equal to Competition", 0.1, "Worse than Competition", 0.05, "No Solution Exists", 0, 5) +
CASE( ETC_price__c , "Better Than (Lower)", 0.15, "Equal To", 0.1, "Worse than (Higher)", 0, 3) +
CASE( ETC_schedule__c , "Better Than (Shorter)", 0.15, "Equal To", 0.1, "Worse than (Longer)", 0, 3)
CustomField.label: Total Pwin
